- Click G at (50, 29) → G moved to (43, 30) (up)

This is the same pattern as with p:
- Click p when far from G → p moves toward G
- Click p when close to G → G moves away
- Click G when far from p → G moves toward p
- Click G when close to p → G moves away
So both p and G repel each other when close. They can never merge by clicking on either one.

4. Maybe the goal involves the white trail
Looking at the image, I see:

- p in the middle
- G below p
Maybe the goal is to get p to touch the ring? Or to get the trail to connect p to the ring in a specific way?
